headline: Colombia Economic Rescue Law Targets $44.6 Trillion State Savings
summary: The Economic Rescue Law proposes $44.6 trillion in state savings through 2027 to curb a default. Contract hires are set to be halved after registering significant increases.
why: Fiscal stabilization measures and sovereign debt risk management are closely watched by international investors holding emerging market sovereign debt.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: The Economic Rescue Law introduces fiscal measures aimed at state savings and default prevention in Colombia.
